range_conflict_assessment.transitive_conflicts: A overlapping B and B overlapping C rejects all three, including A/C if mutually disjoint. This is safe all-ambiguous refusal, not a maximal-independent-set solver.

interpretation.empirical_gate: A conservative applicability gate is not itself proof of a wrong output. The identified bound is not entailed by the cited geometry/syntax; its false-negative/false-positive tradeoff has to be tested instead of being presented as a universal rule.
interpretation.geometry_tolerances: Finite/positive boxes, non-overlap, actual native paths, unique matching and normalized-em proximity are explainable evidence. Exact tolerances still need scale/font/tokenization perturbation calibration.
interpretation.dictionary_scope: CFF-verified glyph identity may justify a finite mapping; source50 audit did not independently rerun historical all-font CFF proofs. Future-font provenance should remain explicit.

findings.general_rule_direction: 反復の支持/競合候補との差と原罫/欄の全被覆を分離し、可変行列にする。信頼度閾値は検証集合で校正する。

findings.general_rule_direction: 漢数字/算用数字の数値構文を元Word列上で解析し、行anchorと罫の支持から対応を決める。

findings.observed_condition: Tableの論理col位置の空欄を保持し、native Glyph advance/axis-aligned四隅/clip内の線を根拠にする。

findings.proposed_test_first: 論理先頭/内部/末尾空欄、結合cell、同開始col複数cell、翻訳/回転/scale、clipped/open/filled pathとglyph-size四角を負例。
findings.general_rule_direction: 構造保存を共通rendererに維持し、geometry許容はlocal em/線幅から導く。候補抽出と意味確定は分離する。

findings.observed_condition: 面積ラベルは英字8字以内/1Word、孤立括弧数字の隣語はCJK3字以上、L/D行末ハイフンの次行は先頭カナ2字などを要求。
findings.explainable_evidence: 原㎡/括弧数字/E61C字形、一意なownerとnative隣接・同baseline/行継続は説明可能。L/Dは化学接頭辞という構文上の意味がある。
findings.generality_gap: 8字/1Word/3字/カナ2字は元字の意味や一意な原字位置の必要条件ではない。狭い安全範囲として説明できるが、全文復元の一般則ではない。
findings.proposed_test_first: 同じ元字/配置でラベル9字・2Words、隣語2/3字、化学語のWord分割・カナ1字+次Wordなど。別単位/別行/下線を負例に。
findings.general_rule_direction: 原字辞書とID付き構文spanを分離し、最小原位置への一意な局所対応を主条件にする。文脈長は検証済み適用範囲として明示する。

cross_cutting_test_first: Keep literal actual-PDF regression tests as observed counterexamples, but add invariance tests derived from the intended source rule before changing a guard.
Preserve the physical source graph while splitting/merging Words and changing irrelevant Unit/Line partitions; compare source-ID mapping rather than fixed strings alone.
Vary record/field counts and label/title lengths across the current boundary, with arbitrary unseen names/amounts and exact expected bindings generated from source geometry.

Translate/scale/rotate valid native geometry with expected corresponding ID transforms; include near-overlap, clipped/open/filled rules, multiple plausible owners and separate adjacent articles as abstain negatives.
Run current11992 wholeAnalysis invariants and inspect every changed original; preserve old literal/regression results and distinguish previously known defects from new regressions.
limitations: Static inspection only; no metamorphic test, parser run, new codegen, new company render, CFF re-scan, training or inference was performed.
Module matrix records predicate/changed-hunk coverage, not a claim of line-by-line semantic verification of all old parser code.
Unadopted company prototypes and frozen initial audit grades were not changed or treated as accepted production.

broader_status: Quoted shape gates replaced. Facility generalization is cache-only and not adopted; other empirical applicability limits remain review work. No blanket claim that the entire parser has no ad hoc assumptions.

local_evidence.finding: standalone line-text postprocess; local historical results concern corrupted text, not current Article/newold/rowspan correctness; README already documents a wrong financial-table permutation preference.
Options has segments=false, min_gain25, repair_gain15, max_pieces5; API returns strings/byte ranges, not Word IDs or Article/Document structures.
CPU local-file model loader; tag() slices token IDs to max_tokens512. Tail has no Break scores and line max can become0. Track exact scored-byte coverage; do not interpret unscored text as clean.
bounded string permutations/unit moves; non-whitespace character preservation is weaker than exact original-ID/DocToken/LF/ASCII/U3000 preservation.
law/page group split and explicit optional --exclude exist; adjacent pages of one announcement and near duplicates are not explicitly grouped.
512-token truncation; dev tokenAP selects the checkpoint. dev-derived repair evaluation is not an untouched final test.
synthetic one-line corruption/clean exact-string metrics; no Article group/newold-role/cell-span metric.

availability.policy: Explicit opt-in and explicit local model path/revision/hash; missing model returns a clear unavailable result. Default parser output remains byte-identical. Do not silently fetch/fallback/relabel unscored pages.

useful_experiments_not_proven_capability.method: Geometry generates original-ID-bound candidate cuts/groups; score text continuity and title/body/name references only to rank them. Keep ambiguous cases unchanged. Existing independent-company/BS+PL/reduction+left-financial actuals are development/guard cases, not final unseen evaluation.

Native/formal headers and source geometry determine permissible roles and article scope. Optional semantic score ranks continuations within those constraints; it must not invent after/before from similar wording alone.

Rank physically permissible ID-preserving permutations; use a suspiciousness score first for human-review ordering. Never choose a financially plausible amount grouping solely from language likelihood.

No local implementation or evidence of task benefit found. If investigated later, treat as a separate opt-in candidate-ranking/relatedness hypothesis against the same frozen gold and no-model baseline; do not assume embeddings establish reading direction, role or company identity.

minimal_evaluation.before_any_run: Freeze parent/source hashes, original PDF hashes, model/config/tokenizer hashes, revision, runtime/device, candidate generator and thresholds. Model-less structured candidate tests run first.
minimal_evaluation.split: Development uses already reviewed defects and clean/ambiguous negatives. Before threshold selection, freeze an untouched source-PDF test split grouped by announcement/document across adjacent pages and duplicate templates; exclude training/dev source IDs/content overlaps. Do not reuse dev or already read company1286 pages as new unseen evidence.
arms: same candidates + existing local ModernBERT scorer/tagger
optional separately implemented RURI scorer; only if model is deliberately supplied
minimal_evaluation.gold: Read whole original, whole body, all Articles/Document/Tables/Runs; label exact original-ID cuts/groups, related pairs/continuations, newold role/scope and correct cells. Fix strict/body initial grades before showing model suggestions.
metrics: boundary precision/recall plus whole-page exact Article grouping
related-pair/continuation preservation and false split/merge count
strict/body ok-minor-major separately; partial improvement distinct from full success
all old ID/raw/bbox/status, Page/body and DocToken/LF/ASCII/U3000 exact for boundary-only changes; glyph additions require separate native proof
minimal_evaluation.runtime: Measure cold model load plus warm per-page p50/p95/worst latency, peak RSS, token/byte scored coverage, candidate/inference counts and CPU threads on a fixed machine. Stop or abstain on time/token budgets, do not treat skipped text as correct.
minimal_evaluation.acceptance: Keep default unchanged. For optional automatic adoption require zero proven new strict-major/cell/value/owner regressions in frozen tests and changed-original review, with exact preservation gates; report uncertainty/sample size and abstentions instead of claiming100%. First phase can be suggestions-only.
minimal_evaluation.full_regression: After the model/generator/threshold are frozen, all11992 mechanically verify preservation and identity of untouched outputs; every changed original is reviewed with whole text/Articles/Doc. No inference attempted in this audit.
